SELECT 
    r.region_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN m.subscriber_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(m.subscriber_id) AS mobile_percentage,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN b.subscriber_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(b.subscriber_id) AS broadband_percentage
FROM 
    regions r
LEFT JOIN 
    mobile_subscribers m ON r.region_id = m.region_id
LEFT JOIN 
    broadband_subscribers b ON r.region_id = b.region_id
GROUP BY

SELECT industry, union_status, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY industry, union_status
SELECT AVG(ph) FROM saltwater_aquaculture WHERE location = 'North Atlantic'
SELECT AVG(price / quantity) FROM dispensary WHERE name = 'Dispensary X'
SELECT MIN(shipment_weight) FROM shipments WHERE port_id IN (SELECT port_id FROM ports WHERE port_name = 'Tokyo' AND country = 'Japan') AND strftime('%Y', ship_date) = '2018';
SELECT program, AVG(energy_savings) OVER (ORDER BY program ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_average FROM energy_efficiency ORDER BY program;
SELECT market_share FROM market_share_2 WHERE hotel_chain = 'Hotel Chain C' AND region = 'South America';
SELECT SUM(D.amount) FROM Donations D JOIN Donors D2 ON D.donor_id = D2.donor_id WHERE D.cause = 'Climate Change Mitigation' AND D2.country = 'Brazil';
SELECT MIN(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MinPlaytime, MAX(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MaxPlaytime FROM Players WHERE Platform = 'Multiplayer' ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM Funding WHERE program IN ('Cultural', 'Women and Non-Binary')
SELECT C.name, SUM(F.hectares) AS total_hectares FROM Countries C JOIN Forests F ON C.code = F.country GROUP BY C.name
SELECT ArtistName FROM MusicSales WHERE Genre = 'Digital' ORDER BY SalesAmount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM hotels WHERE country = 'United States' AND ai_services = TRUE
SELECT MAX(property_price) FROM sustainable_communities
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accidents WHERE vessel_id IN (SELECT id FROM vessels WHERE cargo_capacity > 5000)
SELECT name, SUM(budget) FROM programs WHERE participants > 50 GROUP BY name
SELECT AVG(Consumption) FROM EnergyConsumptionPerCapita WHERE YEAR = 2021
SELECT program_id FROM programs WHERE program_year = 2019 ORDER BY impact_score DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT service, COUNT(*) FROM customer_complaints GROUP BY service
SELECT AVG(total_spending) FROM gaming_facts WHERE country = 'North America';
SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM properties WHERE inclusive_policy = TRUE GROUP BY city
SELECT p.name, s.name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id WHERE s.name != 'Green Cotton Inc.'

SELECT country, SUM(calories) as total_calories
FROM workouts
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY total_calories DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN attendee_age < 12 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM AgeDistribution WHERE event_name = 'Family Day' AND age_distribution_children = TRUE
SELECT s.name, AVG(l.progress) as avg_progress FROM lifelong_learning l JOIN schools s ON l.school_id = s.school_id GROUP BY s.name
SELECT s.supplier_name FROM suppliers s JOIN ingredients i ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id JOIN restaurants r ON i.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id WHERE r.rating = 'Organic'
SELECT Country FROM Players GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(project_id) AS num_projects, SUM(budget) AS total_budget, project_type FROM explainable_ai_projects GROUP BY project_type ORDER BY total_budget DESC
SELECT COUNT(event_id) FROM Events WHERE num_attendees > (SELECT AVG(num_attendees) FROM Events);
SELECT country FROM Contributors ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(players) FROM game_designers WHERE country = 'Africa' AND genre = 'Adventure' AND players > 2000
SELECT project_name, cost FROM creative_ai_projects ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT state, SUM(length) FROM highways GROUP BY state
SELECT gender, SUM(claim_amount) FROM claims GROUP BY gender
